tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// grub chen mai tri ba'i lugs kyi mkha' spyod rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs byin rlabs man ngag dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bidya dha rī ke lī shrī badzra wa rā hī sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ dpal rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin ma'i rim pa bsgom pa ni/ dge ba ma yin pa'i sdom pa rnams brtsam par bya ste/

tha mal pa'i lus 'di mi gtsang bas gang bar blta ba/ blo yi dbang po mig sogs lnga dang*/ las kyi dbang po rkang lag gshang lci lnga la phyi nas sdung pa me long la kha rlangs phog pa ltar bltas te gong bu bsdu ba dang nang nas bshig pa ste chu la rdo ba brgyab pa ltar rjes su bshig pa gnyis gang rung gis de bzhin nyid du rab tu gzhug pa ni/ dang po rkang gnyis ni brla gnyis la'o// brla gnyis ni rked pa'i cha la'o// sked pa ni snying gar ro// lag pa dag ni dpung pa gnyis la'o// dpung pa gnyis ni snying gong bu bsdu ba phyag len la mdzad do/ ga la'o// snying ga ni mgrin pa la'o// mgrin pa ni mgo bo la'o// mgo bo ni sems la'o// sems ni nam mkha' la rab tu gzhug go /nam mkha' ni rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'o// de las yongs su rdzogs pa mo ni/ skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das ma phreng ba'i rig pa 'dzin pa mo'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste/ klu shing gi me tog gi phreng ba can thod pa bsnams pa/ ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par rab tu 'jug pa mo/ me tog gi rwa ba la gnas de nas nam mkha' la rab tu 'phags te mngon du 'gro bar bsams pa'i dus sprul pa dang bcas par bsam gsungs/ sa bon las kyang spro zhing kun tu sdud pa'i lus su bdag nyid bsgom par bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na ji lta ba'i sbyor bas de bzhin du rkang pa g.yon pa'i pus mo'i 'og tu thod pa bcas pa'i lag pa g.yon pas bsdams la rkang pa g.yon sa la brdab par bya'o// de nas sems can thams cad kyi khams ji snyed pa grub pa'i dngul chu lta bur bltas la g.yon pa'i sna'i bu ga nas btung bar bya'o// yang sgyu ma lta bu'i gzugs spro ba dang bsdu ba yang de bzhin du bya'o// bsgoms pas skyo na sngags bzla bar bya'o// de'i spyod pa bshad par bya ste/ sgrub pa po nus pa phra mo thob nas dus dang rigs la sogs pa'i sa nas ston pa ltar gang rung*/

rnams la phan pa'i don du nyi ma'am zla ba gzas bzung ba la me long gi steng du kampa'i sindhū ra la gser gyi thur mas rje btsun ma bris la nye bar spyod pa lngas 'dod yon lnga'i mchod pa ste tshogs mchod mngon par mchod la/ bzlas pa btang ba dang*/ de'i sindhū ra bzung la zangs ma'i snod du bsdus la gzhag par bya'o// laṅga li ya'i shing 'o lam se 'dra ba sbubs can/ bton la rang gi gnas dgon pa sogs su bskyed par bya'o// 'di warāhrīr bsams la zla ba drug tu so sor shing de la nyi ma re re bzhin mchod par bya'o// phyag rgya chen po'i 'bras bu bdag la stsol/ cig gsol ba gdab/ so sor yang dag par mchod pa dang phyag bya'o// 'dir zla ba drug tu yongs su rdzogs par byas la/ rnal 'byor ma dam tshig dang ldan pa gsum ma gcig sogs rnams la nye bar spyod pa lnga dang*/ ston mo byas la phyag byas te gnang ba nos la/ laṅga li ya'i dbus su sindhū ras dgang bar bya'o// zur drug pa'i rnam pa sindhū ras dpral ba la byas la 'phyo bar bya'o// thod pa bzung la smyon pa'i spyod pa spyad do// zla ba drug tu skud pa'i tshong dus kyi grong dang nye bar bud med mang po dag la g.yon du bskor bar brtsam par bya'o// smyon pa'i spyod pas spyad do// zla ba drug na mtshams med pa lnga byed pa nges kyang 'grub bo/ gong du laṅga li ya'i sgrub par zla ba drug dang*/ spyod pa zla ba drug ste bcu gnyis na/ bdag gi dpral ba'i 'khor lo de gang gi dpral bar byung na de rnal 'byor ma yin pas de la gsol ba btab pas byin gyis brlabs te/ /phreng ba'i sngags bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ badzra warṇa nī ye/ oṃ badzra bai re tsa nī ye/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zlos pa'i dus su oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye badzra warṇa nī ye badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes par bzla'o/

padma can gyi rigs kyi rang byung gi me tog dang ga pur dang tsandan dang sbyar la rgya skyegs dang bsres te bri bar bya'o// zhes bya ba ni brgyud pa'i man ngag gi rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i sgrub thabs slob dpon gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so/ rgyud du ma dang sgrub thabs gnyis bag ri mi 'dra ba kun phyag len sgrub thabs bzhin byed gsungs// kho bos rje btsun dza ya shrī sen lo tsā ba dang bcas pa las zhus so// mchan 'di rnams rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis btab pa'o// maṅgalaṃ// ༈ /mai tri mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs byin rlabs dang bcas pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badzra yo gi n+yai/ 'gro la rab chags dmar ba'i mdangs ldan zhal gcig spyan gsum gyen du gzigs// g.yas g.yon phyag zhabs rtsen pa'i gar gyis mi rtog bde chen zung 'jug tshul// mkha' 'gro dpag med 'phro 'du'i lus can srid gsum bde bas tshim mdzad ma// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso la btud de de yi bsnyen sgrub cho ga bshad// dbang thob dam tshig rnam dag cing*// rjes gnang cho gas rgyud dag pa// lung dang man ngag ldan pa yi// rnal 'byor can gyis don gnyis bsgrub// de la gsum ste/ sngon du bsnyen pas mnyes par bya ba dang*/ rang don dngos grub bsgrub par bya ba dang*/ gzhan don slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su mchod pa dang gtor ma ci 'grub pa bsham/ bde ba'i stan la skyil krung gis 'khod de dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar dran par byas la/ thod par chang la bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba dngos su bshams pa'am med na yid kyis bsam/ lag pa g.yon pa mtheb srin rtse sprad pas mdun nas bzung nas g.yon skor du 'bru gsum brjod cing chos 'byung bri/

dbus su bam̐ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsir byin brlab/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yon pa'i mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams te sor mo lnga'i rtsa bar go cha'i lha mo drug gi sngags brjod cing thig le dkar po'i gnas de dag tu 'bru rnams gsal btab nas/ lag pa gnyis phan tshun mnyes la/ g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te lce la bzhag cing gnas gsum du thig le bya'o// de nas mig la sogs pa'i blo'i dbang po lnga dang*/ rkang lag la sogs pa las kyi dbang po lnga dang*/ phyi'i yul rnams gdod ma nas dag pa dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams la snying rje'i blos de bzhin nyid du rab tu gzhug cing*/ de yang gong bu bsdu ba dang rjes su gzhig pa gnyis las/ phyag len snga ma ltar mdzad pas/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi lus dang khams gsum thams cad gang bas khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu/ me long la has btab pa ltar rim gyis bsdus te rang gi lus la thim/ lus kyi rkang pa gnyis brla la/ de lto ba la/ de sked pa la/ de snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la/ de snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de sems la/ de nam mkha' la/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar bsams la/ de'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin mar gyur pa ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du btegs nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/

manda ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba g.yon na 'dzin cing rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mor mos pa bya/ de bzhin du snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mtshogs mar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇḍi kar mos pa bya'o// de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar g.yon du bskor zhing mig gyen du bltas la phaiṃ gyi sgra drag tu brjod/ yid kyis snying ga'i bam̐ las 'phros pa'i bod kyis rang 'dra'i ye shes spyan drangs nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs dgug gzhug bya'o// de nas dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'am/ yang na dbu rgyan rang chas su bsam mo// bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// //de'i lte bar 'khor lo zur drug pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi zur bzhi la dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyis bskor ba g.yon du myur du 'khor bar dmigs shing*/ de dang dus mnyam du smin mtshams su dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor bar bsams la/ yid bzung zhing rlung kha sbyor bsgoms pas drod dang mi rtogs skye bar 'gyur ro// gsang gnas su 'khor lo 'khor ba la dmigs pas bde drod 'bar bar 'gyur ro// rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// //de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir spyod yul gyi gnas su 'jug par 'dod pas mkha' 'gro spro bsdu dang bcas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing*/ ma na bhaṃ ga dang*/ dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor rim gyis phyin te/ manda ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du rnams skyes pa'i ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par zhugs par bsams la/

zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i mthil ril brdabs pas brtan g.yo thams cad bskyod cing sems can gyi rgyud bde bas gang zhing 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rnams rlung 'jug pa dang bstun nas g.yon gyi thod par bsdus shing sna bug g.yon nas btungs pas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar bsam zhing rlung gzung*/ phyir gtong dus sems can thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pas phyogs bcur spro zhing slar yang bsdu pa sngar bzhin bya'o// de ltar ri gnyis kyi rtse mor spos shing bsgoms la/ des skyo na sngar gyi gnas su 'dug par bsams la bzlas pa bya'o// de'i tshul ni bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma g.yon du bskor ba'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis spel/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes 'jug par bsam zhing*/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum bya'o gsungs na'ang 'bum phrag gsum mam bzhi bzla ste/ yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis la// bzlas bsgom sum 'bum bya bar bshad// ces dang*/ rtsod dus bzhi 'gyur du ni bzla zhes 'byung bas so// //thun mtshams srod thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma lnga'am gcig bshams la mkha' 'gro lnga la dbul te/ byin rlabs mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar mkha' 'gro lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa'i zhal nas byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma drangs par bsams te phyag rgya lnga dang bcas pas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ā karṣa ya akarṣa ya/ pra we sha ya pra we sha ya/ to ṣa ya to ṣa ya/ sarba ḍā ki nī nāṃ hṛ da yaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ oṃ/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hrām̐/

oṃ padma ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hrām̐ḥ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ sarba yo gi nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ha ha hi hi dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra yo gi n+yāḥs ma ya st+waṃ dṛ shya rakṣa rakṣa hoḥ zhes pa gsum la sogs pas dbul/ gal te gtor ma lnga yod cing so sor dbul na hūm̐ phaṭa yan chad kun la sbyar zhing mkha' 'gro lnga so so'i sngags la oṃ sarba yo gi nī man chad sbyar ba gsum la sogs pas so sor dbul/ mchod yon la sogs pa dang bdud rtsis mchod la/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes la sogs pa'am/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badzra muḥs gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang zhing dge ba bsngo/ 'di ni las dang po pa'i dbang du byas pa ste/ sems cung zad brtan nas gtor ma yid kyis bsams te phul kyang rung gsungs so// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur bsam zhing*/ dpa' mo'i go cha dang tshom rngams sngags kyis bsrung ba byas la/ bdag dang snang ba 'di thams cad lha/ brjod pa dang grags pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam rtog ye shes su shes pa'i ngang nas chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o// kha zas la longs spyod pa'i tshe kha zas la g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis reg cing 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir bsam/ bdag rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas me 'bar ba'i me lce'i khrod na snying gar rje btsun ma la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor zhing bla ma dbu'i cha la bzhugs par bsam/

lto bar 'jig rten pa'i tshogs bsams la de dag mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyad do// nyal ba'i tshe gong bu bsdu ba'am/ rjes su gzhig pa gang rung gis stong par bsams la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis lha mo'i skur ldangs la snod bcud thams cad sgyu mar spro/ khrus byed na dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag par bsam zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod cing bkru'o// //de ltar sgom bzlas la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnyis pa rang gi don du dngos grub bsgrub pa ni/ nyi ma gzas 'dzin dus sindhū ra'i sgrub pa bya zhing*/ de nas laṅga li ya'i sgrub pa zla ba drug byas nas shin tu spros med kyi spyod pa spyad na/ rnal 'byor ma mi'i bu mo'i rnam pa can dang 'phrad nas mkha' spyod la sogs pa myur du 'grub par 'gyur ro// zhib tu gzhan du shes par bya'o// //de ltar bsnyen sgrub sngon du song nas don gsum pa gzhan don slob ma rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga ni/ nag po'i phyogs kyi tshes bcu la dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas khang phyags dar dang skyang nul byas par bla bre dang rgyan dgram/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten bsham/ maṇḍal gyi gzhi ba byung lnga dang dri bzang bdud rtsi dang bcas pas byug der rdul tshon dmar pos chos 'byung gru gsum bris pa'i dbus su re khā dkar pos padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du bde skyong 'chi med dang sbyar ba'i myos byed kyis bkang ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa gzhag 'khar ba'i maṇḍal dri ma med pa la chang gis gtor te phyis pa'i steng du sindhū ra dar tshags kyis btsags la snyoms par dgram/ der lag pa g.yon gser gyi thur ma dang bcas pas chos 'byung gi dbus su lha mo'i sku me ri'i bar yongs su rdzogs pa ri'i gzugs gnyis dang bcas pa bris pa sngar gyi thod pa'i steng du gzhag go

/de'i steng du dar dmar po'i gur gyis g.yogs shing khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma brgyad bsham/ bum pa lnga'am ka pā la bdud rtsis bkang ba lnga gzhag gsungs/ yang bum pa gcig gtsang bar byas la mgul chings dang kha rgyan bcud rnams dang bcas pa bshams pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang pos gang ba rdo rje gzungs thag dang bcas pa gzhag thod pa'am med na dung chos sam ting phor bdud rtsi ril bu sbyar ba'i chus yongs su gang ba bzhi phyogs bzhir gzhag bdag gi mdun du nang mchod dang rdo rje dril bu gzhag cing*/ gzhan yang gdong g.yogs dang me tog phreng ba dang sha chen la sogs pa rnams bsham mo// de nas phyi ma red kyi dus su rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa gral la rim pas 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs la rje btsun ma'i mngon rtogs rim pa gnyis bsgom/ bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de nas mdun gyi mchod pa rnams la bdud rtsi gtor zhing sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod rnams su oṃ āḥhūm̐ las mchod yon la sogs pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che bar bskyed la so so'i sngags dang 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas maṇḍal bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du rje btsun ma sgrub thabs ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i steng du bla ma dang*/ khor yug tu dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa bsam/ gong du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra yo gi ni arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hās mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du rol mo'i bar 'don pa bsgyur zhing dbul/ sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis blangs te/

rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang*/ chos skyong dang phyogs skyong dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod cing byin/ mthar rang gi lce la myang zhing oṃ gsum ma brjod de pad kor gyi phyag rgya dang*/ 'khyud pa'i tshul byas pas mnyes par bya'o// de nas yid kyis sprul pa dang bdag pos ma bzung ba'i mchod pas mchod/ yum gyi rkang brgyad dam/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pas bstod/ gtor ma dang rje btsun ma la oṃ gsum mar oṃ badzra a rallihoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya st+waṃ dri shya hoḥzhes btags pas dbul/ gnyis pa sgos kyi chos skyong la/ de nas lnga'am ma grub na gcig mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gong gi cho gas dbul/ tha ma gzhi bdag dang de'i lhag ma rigs drug la sbyin no// de nas slob ma gzhug pa'i don du gsol ba gdab ste/ rdo rje dril bu spos 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan ye shes rdo rje mchog /rig 'dzin rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal// snying rje'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du// slob ma gzhug par 'tshal lags na// ji ltar rgyal ba kun gyis khyod// ye shes rgya mtshor byin brlabs pa// de bzhin du ni ye shes rol// sems can 'di la byin brlab rigs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab pas gtso mos gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas bum pa bsangs shing sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha'i gos kyis mgul pa g.yogs shing dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan par bskyed pa'i nang du rje btsun ma yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod cing bstod de/

bdag gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'od zer ltar 'phros pa gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul nas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang ba bsam zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ mthar mchod cing bstod la dung chos kyi chu blugs pas rkyen byas te bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pas bsam mo// de nas dad pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan zhing*/ dbang gis smin par byas pa'i slob ma khrus byas shing phyag 'tshal nas gral la rim pas 'khod pa la/ bla mas srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las bdag brgal zhing gzhan bsgral ba'i phyir/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mai tri mkha' la spyod pa'i byin rlabs kyi sgo dbye ba zhu snyam pa gyis la maṇḍal lan gsum phul te bla ma la gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis// 'gro ba byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// thams cad rig par rang gis byin// de bzhin bdag la'ang mgon po kyai// da lta nyid du sbyin par rigs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de nas go skabs yangs shing byed par spro na/ shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi nas maṇḍal re dang tshig res gsol ba gdab/ de tsam ma grub na yid kyis de ltar bsam zhing*/ dngos su maṇḍal lan bzhi dbul/ rje btsun ma la gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin brlabs pa// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag la yang*// ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol// zhes lan bzhi brjod du gzhug go /de nas gdong bcings te me tog gi phreng ba gtad de/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing sumbhas bsang*/ bdud rtsi lce la gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/

snying ga'i nang du zla ba la rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gnyis kas bsam/ bla mas slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpa da yā mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhya badzra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed nas/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes gsung zhing dkyil 'khor du khrid par mos pa gyis zhes brjod/ de nas slob ma rnams lha mo'i skur bsam pa ni/ gong bu bsdu ba nas go cha bcing ba'i bar sgrub thabs ltar gnyis kas bsgom zhing gnas gsum byin brlab/ lha mo'i sku las mkha' 'gro du ma spro zhing sdud pa'i lus can du bsam zhing yid gzung*/ yang gong bu bsdu ba'am rjes su gzhig par gang rung gi dmigs pa bya/ yang skad cig gis lha mo'i skur bsam/ de'i lte bar 'khor lo zur drug pa yig 'bru dang bcas pa 'khor ba dang*/ gsang ba'i gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ mdzod spur 'khor bas lus drod dang bde bas gang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i rnam pas lus la thim nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes zhugs par dpon slob gnyis kas bsgom zhing gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas kyi dud pas bdug ḍā ma ru la sogs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag po bya zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod/ de ltar dmigs pa de dag spogs shing phab pas lus ngag yid gsum la ye shes babs pa'i rtags ci rigs pa 'byung ngo*// de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje gram du bzhag cing oṃ tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod do// de nas me tog gi phreng ba de rje btsun ma'i dbu gtsug tu phul bar sgoms zhes brjod la/

dngos su las kyi rdo rjes dbul zhing*/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥzhes brjod du gzhug go /phreng ba de nyid sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas slob ma'i mgo la bzhag cing*/ oṃ pra ti gṛhṇe i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la oṃ zhes brjod do// de nas oṃ badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥbram̐ zhes brjod cing gdong g.yogs phye la dkyil 'khor bstan no// slob mas bltas te gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing lha mo'i sku dngos su mthong snyam du bsam mo// de nas dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul te gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug de nas rje btsun ma'i mdun du rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la slob ma lha mor bsgom du gzhug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yas na rgyal mtshan g.yon na ba dan khor yug tu mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pa brjod cing gtso mos bum chus dbang bskur bar bsams la/ dngos su/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing*// zhes sogs kyi mthar/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ tsakra wī ra st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas slob ma'i lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sogs sangs rgyas lngas dbu brgyan par bsam mo// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu gnas pa'am gnas par mos la lha mo'i skur bsgom/

bla ma'i thugs ka'i sngags kyi phreng ba chad cing bla ma'i zhal nas slob ma'i khar zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la g.yon skor du 'khod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum rjes su bzlas pas sngags kyi lung byin la/ bla ma'i lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje dang bcas pa slob ma'i mgo bor btud cing sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas slob ma lha mo'i phyag zhabs kyi rnam 'gyur ltar byed du bcug la/ de'i g.yon du bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yas su rdo rje gtad cing gong gi bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa sgom du bcug la thod pa'i bdud rtsi'i thung ngu gzhug go /de dag ni sngags dang spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// de ltar khyed kyis bum pa'i dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas sha chen nam sha phal pa mar du btsos pa dang maṇḍal gyi 'og gi bdud rtsi lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du sbyin nas gsang ba'i dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas lha mo'i dpral ba mgrin pa snying ga gsum nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le byas pas sku gsung thugs kyis dngos grub stsal zhing lus sems la bde ba rgyas par bsams la/ des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob bo zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas chos thams cad skye med spros bral du ngo sprad la 'dzin med kyi ngang la re zhig gzhag go /des dbang bzhi pa thob pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed/ rje btsun ma'i sgrub thabs mkha' spyod sgrub pa dang*/ ras bris bri thabs dang bcas pa tshar gcig bshad la sgrub par gdams/ slob mas dam tshig dang sdom pa mdor bsdus te khas blang ba dang*/ lus longs spyod thams cad gtang rag tu phul la/ dngos su ci 'byor pa'i yon phul zhing bka' drin che ba lags so zhes tshig gi gtang rag dbul lo// de nas gtor ma gtong na skabs 'dir btang la dga' ston la longs spyad/

lag mchod sngar ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod byas la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa sindhū ra'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ dge ba bsngo/ sindhū ra bsdus nas snod bzang por blugs la phyis kyi maṇḍal 'bri ba la bsres na shin tu byin rlabs che gsungs/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gtsang sar gtang*/ bdag nyid bsrungs la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// lo ke shwa ra ri khrod dbang phyug mai tri pa// ka ma la dang des rje dza ya se na dang*// dar ma yon tan grags pa rgyal mtshan chos kyi rje// rin chen tshogs dang yon tan mtha' yas 'od zer can// nye brgyud yin zhing ring brgyud gzhan du shes par bya// rgyal ba'i ye shes sgyu ma las byung bud med sgyu ma'i tshul 'dzin pa'i// bud med ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul 'di gnyis med rdo rje'i gsung rab dang*/

mai tri pa/ /man ngag ji bzhin bdag gis bkod la bdag blo'i nyes gang bzod par gsol// dge ba gang des ma lus 'gro kun mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug nyid gyur cig /rnam 'byed stobs chung le lo'i dbang gyur kun dga'i ming can gang yin la// blo gros rab gsal sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa gzhon nu la sogs pa'i// don gnyer 'ga' yis bskul ba'i zhal ngor mkha' spyod sgrub pa rjes gnang bcas// lcags pho byi lo'i brgyad pa'i brgyad la spru lung nags phug dgon par sbyar// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra yo gi n+yai/ yon tan mtha' yas rgyal ba kun gyi dngos// mkhyen brtse bsil ba'i 'od tshogs rab mnga' ba// mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso la bstod par bgyi// gdod nas rnam dag chos dbyings nam mkha' la// glo bur dri ma'i rdul gyis ma gos shing*// mkha' ltar mtha' yas brtan g.yo kun gyi dngos// mkha' spyod chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zung 'jug bde la rol pa'i rnam 'phrul gyis// srid gsum ma lus bde bas tshim mdzad nas// zag med bde chen dbyings su thim mdzad ma// bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la 'dud// gang zhig gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs mkhyen nas// de dang de la de yi mos pa bzhin// rnam 'phrul sna tshogs rnam par sprul mdzad ma// rig 'dzin sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa'i sku brnyes kyang*// 'gro la brtse phyir dpal gyi ri sogs rtser// rin chen khang pa'i ldum rwa yid 'ong bar// rol zhing rtse bar ston la phyag 'tshal lo// khyed gsung ming tshig yi ges dben gyur kyang*// phyag 'tshal yi ge gsum pa'i rigs sngags kyi// mtha' yas gsung gi gsang bas 'gro kun la// spyod dang grol ba stsol la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog mtshan ma'i spros pa nyer zhi yang*// ji bzhin ji snyed mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor las// thugs rje'i 'od kyis sa gsum gsal mdzad ma// zab cing rgya che'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum rnam dag sku yi gzhal yas khang*// sum cu rtsa gnyis sngags kyis rab brgyan zhing*// e wam̐ g.yung drung thugs kyi rin chen na// mi rtog bde chen 'byung gnas mchog la 'dud// sems can don la brtson pa'i rnam 'phrul dang*// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag med spro bsdu yis// mtha' yas 'gro ba bde la 'god mdzad ma// phrin las phrin las spyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod dang gnyis med bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// khyod kyi byin rlabs rjes su gnang ba thob// dad dang brtson pas bsgrub cing gsol 'debs na// 'di la khyed kyi thugs rje cis mi 'jug

/'on kyang skal ngan bdag blo'i nyes pa yis// tshe 'dir rjes su 'dzin pa'i skal med na// 'chi kha'am bar dor khyod kyis rjes bzung nas// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par mdzad du gsol// khyod thugs ye shes rgya mtshor bdag zhugs shing*// dngos grub rin chen bang mdzod sgo phye nas// chos kyis phongs pa'i skye rgu tshim byed cing*// phan bde'i 'byung gnas mchog tu 'gyur bar mdzod// ma ltar brtse bas khyod kyis 'gro kun la// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis byin brlabs shing*// gsang chen bla med theg pa rab zhon nas// thar pa chen po'i grong du phyin par mdzod// grub pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma la// bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig 'di dag /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' smon lam gyis// mi rje'i bzhugs gnas yul chos khab tu sbyar// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /grub chen mai tri pa'i lugs kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga bklags pas grub par bkod pa mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ 'khor lo'i mgon dang dbyer med pa'i// rig pa 'dzin ma'i rje btsun mar// btud nas de yi byin rlabs tshul// mkha' spyod grub pa'i rgyan du sbyin// 'di la bzhi/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi cho ga 'phros don gzhan cung zad bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba'o// dang po ni/ dbang thob cing byin rlabs zab mos rgyud smin pa/ dam tshig dang sdom par ldan cing gzhi'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can gyi tshe dkyil 'khor gyi bsham bkod dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad sogs spru lung ba kun dga' smon lam gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha las 'byung ba ltar 'du bya/ de'ang ngag chos pa'i yig char sku 'bri ma thub na tshon phung tsam gyis chog pa dang*/

mchod pa dang*/ bum pa bca' ba sogs kyang spyi ltar byas pas chog par gsungs pa spros pa bsdus pa'i tshe dgongs par mngon na'ang*/ rgya gzhung las snga ma ltar 'byung bas legs so// gzhan yang cho ga gzhan dang ma 'brel na sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ḍā ma ru dang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa byed na nye logs ci bde bar tshogs kyi yo byad dang bcas pa'ang 'du bya/ gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs rnams nā ro mkha' spyod sogs dang 'dra/ tshogs pa mang po yod na zhu 'bul phyag bco brgyad ma bde kye ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi/ bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum bskyed/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba'o// dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro/ sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyang nā ro mkha' spyod sogs kyi cho ga las 'byung ba ltar bya/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma'i skur gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spru lung pa'i yig cha'i dkyus nas 'byung ba ltar 'bru gsum brjod cing myang ba nas bzung dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i bar dang*/ spro na slar yang rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ rdzogs rim dang spyod pa'i dmigs pa cung zad bsgom zhing*/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas la/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing sumbhas bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sogs kyi mal du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes bsgyur/ mdun bskyed kyi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang*/ khor yug tu dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ spro na nā ro mkha' spyod sogs kyi cho ga rgyas pa las 'byung ba ltar mchod phreng spros te byas kyang rung mod/ dkyus ltar na phyi mchod dang*/ nang bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'i rjes/ yid byung gi mchod pa na mo chos kyi dbyings sogs nas/ tsā ya swā hā zhes pa'i bar dang*/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams nā ro mkha' spyod ltar bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas rjes 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis brlabs te dang po rje btsun ma la dkyus ltar dbul/ gnyis pa nag po chen po sogs chos skyong 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams la gtor chog ltar dbul ba'am/ ma grub na/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal rdo rje nag po chen po sogs chos skyong ye shes pa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a ka ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga sogs kyis bstod/ chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/

gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar gyi gtor ma lnga mkha' 'gro sde lnga la dbul te/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sogs las sngags kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki sogs gtor ma dbul/ oṃ sarba ḍā ki sogs kyis bstab pa bya/ gtor ma gcig las med na gtor ma so sor 'bul ba'i sngags rnams sbrel/ mthar oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs de nyid lnga pa'am/ ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs shlo ka gcig gis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyi 'dod don gsol/ tha ma gzhi bdag la 'bul ba ni/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥs mgron dgug bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ arghaṃ sogs kyi mchod/ gzhi bdag gnas bdag 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra gatstshaḥs gshegs su gsol la lhag ma a kā ro lan gsum gyis rigs drug spyi la bsngo/ slob ma gzhug pa'i ched du gsol ba gdab pa dkyus ltar bya/ gsum pa ni/ bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha'i gos kyis mgul pa g.yogs shing dpag bsam gi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su chos 'byung gi nang du nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed ltar/ phyi nang gis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyi bstod/ bdag gi thugs ka nas sogs bzlas pa dang 'od zhu bar dkyus ltar bya'o// bzhi pa la gnyis/ thog mar bdag nyid 'jug pa dang*/ slob ma rjes su gzung ba dngos so// dang po ni/ spru lung pa'i yig char mi gsal yang*/

ngag dbang chos grags pas spro na bya gsungs pa ltar yig cha gzhan las kyang 'byung bas slob ma la ji tsam bskur ba'i byin rlabs kyi chos rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'i slob ma nyer lnga man zung du ma gyur pa rnams khrus bya/ phyag dang 'jug pa'i yon phul te rang rang gi gral du 'khod pa la slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa rnams kyang legs par gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su 'brel pa'i zab rgyas kyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bka' babs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lcags ri'i khongs las mi 'da' ba'i snyan brgyud gser chos bcu gsum zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan/ mchog bsgrubs pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum du grags pa'i ya gyal/ grub chen mai tri guptas rgyud ral pa gyen brdzes la brten nas legs par bkral ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ paṇa grub dza ya se nas mdzad pa'i rjes gnang gi yi ge dang bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag gzhes ltar rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin pa rtsen ma'i byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub pa la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas/ dngos gzhi slob ma la bya ba la/ lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ zhugs nas byin rlabs dbang bzhi'i tshul du bskur ba rnam pa gnyis su yod pa las/ thog mar byin rlabs kyi 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du slob dpon la rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas maṇḍal lan gsum 'bul bar zhu/

de ltar maṇḍal phul nas phyag thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ji ltar rdo rje sems dpa' yis// 'gro ba byang chub bsgrub pa'i phyir// ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor mar// thams cad rig par rang gis byin// de bzhin bdag la'ang mgon po kye// da lta nyid du sbyin par rigs// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang gzhan gyi pha mas thog drangs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum brjod/ ces rgyud dag par byas nas/ sngon chad rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa'am/ zhugs kyang slar yang bskyar nas 'jug pa'i mtshon byed du ras yug dmar po res gdong dam du bcings par mos pa mdzod/ ā kham̐ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes gdong bcing*/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang mjal ba'i tshe phyag stong par mjal du mi btub pas u dumba ra la sogs pa'i me tog gi phreng ba re byin par mos pa mdzod/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ zhes pas me tog gi phreng ba gtad la/ bar chad bsal ba'i slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro mo khaṇḍa ro hi'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te khyed rang rnams la byin rlabs zab mo bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par mos pa mdzod/ sumbha sogs brjod cing bum chu gtor/

slar yang slob dpon gyis bdud rtsi khyed rang rnams kyi ljags thog dang*/ sku lus la gtor te nang rtsa khams kyi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba byas par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de ltar byas pas lus thams cad ye shes phyi bdud rtsis gang zhing zag med kyi bde bas byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de nas gsang sngags nang gi sems bskyed pa'i slad du khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor cha shas yongs su rdzogs pa bco lnga'i nya gang ba lta bu skya 'khyil ba re gsal btab la/ de'i steng du don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa gyen du langs pa byung bar mos te bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba yo gi tsitta utpā da yā mi/ slob dpon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje bzhag pas brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥsiddhya badzra ya thā su kha/ zhes pas bden gnyis dbyer med du sems bskyed nas/ gzhan yang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gsang sngags kyi kun spyod thams cad snod dang mi ldan pa rnams kyi mdun du ma smra zhig ces gsang bar gdams pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rigs su zhugs gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas/ nang 'jug gi slad du rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes gsungs shing dkyil 'khor gyi drung du khrid nas shar phyogs su 'khod par mos pas/

slar yang khyad par can gyi don la nan tan du gsol ba 'dab pa'i yid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i rje btsun ma tha mi dad pa la maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan bzhi'i bar du gnang bar zhu zhes mtshams sbyar la/ go skabs yangs shing byed par spro na dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs so so dang*/ de tsam ma grub na yid kyis de ltar byed par bsam zhing dngos su maṇḍal re dang*/ lha mo lus ngag yid kyis su// ye shes rgya mtsho khyod phyag 'tshal// ji ltar sangs rgyas stobs chen gyis// thams cad ye shes byin brlabs pa// de bzhin bdag rgyud dag la yang*// ye shes rgyun gyis mdzad du gsol// zhes spel la lan bzhi bya'o/

'di spru lung ba'i yig char gong du 'byung bar skabs 'dir byas na spyi dang mthun pas legs/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas nang 'jug gi dngos gzhi ye shes dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po mar me ltar 'bar ba zhig gsal btab ste/ chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i ngang nas bam̐ yig la sems zhugs pa bzhin cher gyis gtad pas de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang rang gi lus dang khams gsum thams cad gang bas khams gsum thams cad 'od du zhu/ me long la has btab pa ltar rim gyis bsdus te rang rang gi lus la thim/ lus kyi rkang pa gnyis brla la/ de lto ba la/ de sked pa la/ de snying ga la/ lag pa gnyis dpung pa la/ de snying ga la/ de mgrin pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de sems la/ de nam mkha' la/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal bar gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de'i ngang las chos 'byung gi nang du padma dang nyi ma la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig dmar po las khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin par gyur pa ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du bteg nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ manda ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng ba g.yon na 'dzin cing rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan la lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/

snying gar ham̐ yam̐ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hrīṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ mtshogs mar hriṃ hrīṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu huṃ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇḍi ka dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ mig sogs bu ga thams cad la hūm̐ yig re res mtshan pa/ mkha' 'gro du ma spro zhing sdud pa'i skur gyur par mos pa dang bcas te sems 'dzin par zhu/ yang khyed rang rnams lha mor gsal ba bam̐ yig chen po gcig tu gyur/ de je che je che la mthar nam mkha' dang 'dres pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang du mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ slar yang khyed rang rnams lha mo'i skur lam ste gsal ba'i lte bar chos 'byung zur drug pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dang bcas gsal btab nas g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems bzung bas drod kyi ye shes skyes/ 'khor lo de nyid gsang gnas su 'khor ba dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon du 'khor ba la sems bzung bas bde ba'i ye shes skyes/ mdzod spur dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du 'khor ba la sems bzung bas mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes shing lus thams cad drod dang bde bas gang*/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te lus la sib sib thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgyud la zhugs par mos pa mdzod ces brda sbyar la/ gu gul gyis bdug ḍā ma rus thog drangs pa'i rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya zhing oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod pas dbab/ de ltar ye shes phab pas lus bde zhing gar byed pa dang*/ ngag saṃ skṛ ta'i skad smra ba dang*/ yid la bde bsal mi rtog pa'i nyams ci rigs pa 'byung ba yin la/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste brtan par byas par mos pa mdzod/

tiṣṭha badzra zhes brjod/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la me tog 'dor ba ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ rim pa ltar byon nas g.yon pa'i phyag gis me tog de rje btsun ma'i dbu la phul bar mos te/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gsung zhing me tog 'dor bar zhu/ de nyid slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste sngags kyi phreng bas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ pra ti gṛhna st+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badzra ne tra a pa hā ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥbram̐/ zhes pas khyed rang rnams kyi ma rig pa'i ling tog dang mig ras lhan cig tu bsal te/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha ngo bstan pa ni/ 'di na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs pa yin te/ chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad nyi'i steng du bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo rig pa 'dzin ma rtsen ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dza ba'i me tog ltar dmar ba'i mdangs can/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer dang bcas pas steng du phyogs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyen du gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bu thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa dang bcas pas zhabs g.yon gyi sgyid khung nas 'khyud cing steng du bteg nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gsol ba'i tshul du 'dzin pa/ g.yas na rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'dzin pas zhabs g.yas pus mo btsugs pa'i rting pa la bsnun pa/ manda ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du'i me tog gi phreng pa g.yon na 'dzin cing rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa ste/ mdor na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rig pa 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du gzigs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

des dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams grub nas/ zhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes pas gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su rin po che'i khri dang pad zla'i gdan la khyed rang rnams rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan/ khor yug tu mchod pa'i sprin tshogs dang bcas pa la/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa dang*/ mchod pa dang bkra shis kyi glu dang bcas pa brjod cing gtso mo'i phyag na bum pa dkar po ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ las kyi rdo rjes bum pa slob ma'i phyogs su bteg slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing me tog 'thor ba dang bcas te/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung ba// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rje rol mdzad pa'i// bden pa des kyang bde mchog la gnas bkra shis shog /he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku mnga' ba// ha ha'i gad rgyangs sa gsum g.yo bar byed// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa bdud kyi glad 'gems pa'i// bde mchog 'khor lo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// e wam̐ mnyam par sbyor ba sngags kyi sku// ā li kā li gnyis med rol pa'i gsung*// oṃ gyi ngo bor son pa'i thugs mnga' ba// rdo rje phag mo'i bkra shis deng 'dir stsol// zhes brjod pa'i mthar bum pa spyi bor bzhag cing*/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ tsakra wī ra st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas khyed rang rnams kyi lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa sogs sangs rgyas rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo me tog ma la sogs pa rnams kyi kyang mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ nai wi dya'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ de nas khyed rang rnams dkyil 'khor gyi nub phyogs su 'khod pa'am/ 'khor bar mos te sngags kyi bzlas lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba bye ru star la brgyus pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas thon/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang*/ byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs te/ zhal nas thon pa'i sngags phreng dang dbyer med du gyur pa de nyid khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma'i sku can du gyur pa'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i bam̐ yig gi mthar g.yon skor du dmar 'khyil gyis 'khod par mos pa byas te sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ ces brjod pa oṃ gsum ma'i rjes zlos byed du gzhug de brtan par bya ba'i slad du slob dpon gyis lag pa g.yon pa rdo rje dang bcas pa khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag cing sngags brjod pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la thal mo spyi bor bzhag cing sngags brjod/ spyod pa'i rjes gnang gi slad du/ khyed rang rnams rje btsun ma'i sku'i rnam 'gyur du byas pa'i phyag g.yon du bdud rtsi dang*/ g.yas su rdo rje bzung nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i phyir spyod yul gyi gnas su 'jug par 'dod pas mkha' 'gro spro bsdu dang bcas nam mkha' la 'phur zhing*/ ma na bhaṃ ga dang*/ dpal gyi ri'i rtse mor rim gyis phyin te/ manda ra dang*/ mya ngan med pa dang*/ yongs 'du rnams skyes pa'i ldum gyi rwa ba rtse mo brgyad dang ldan pa'i rin po che'i khang par zhugs par bsams la/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i mthil ri la brdabs pas brtan g.yo thams cad bskyod cing sems can thams cad kyi rgyud bde bas gang zhing 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rnams rlung 'jug pa dang bstun nas g.yon gyi thod par bsdus shing sna bug g.yon nas btungs pas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang bar mos pa mdzod/ ces sgom du gzhug cing bdud rtsi sbyin/ de dag ni sngags dang spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ste/ de ltar na khyed rnams kyis bum pa'i dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// gsang dbang gi slad du/ thabs bde ba chen po mtshon par byed pa sha chen nam sha phal pa mar la gtsos pa phyag g.yas dang*/ shes rab stong pa nyid mtshon par byed pa sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'og gi thod pa'i bdud rtsi phyag g.yon du byin te dbang skur bar mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la oṃ gsum ma'i sngags brjod bzhin du byin/ des khyed rnams kyis gsang ba'i dbang bskur byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi slad du/ sindhū ra'i maṇḍal gyi lha mo'i gnas gsum nas blangs pa'i rdul tshon gyis khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thig le bkod pa la brten nas/

rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad stsal zhing lus sems la bde bas khyab cing rgyas par mos pa mdzod/ rtsa sngags brjod bzhin du thig le bya/ des khyed rnams kyis shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// dbang bzhi pa'i slad du/ chos thams cad skye 'gag med pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral bar shes par byas te de'i ngang du cung zad re mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ des khyed rnams kyis dbang bzhi pa byin rlabs kyi tshul gyis thob pa yin no// bar 'dir sgrub thabs kyi lung bklag cing*/ rjes dam tshig khas blang*/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba rnams spyi ltar bya/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mai tri mkha' spyod du grags pa'i byin rlabs kyi bka' zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa yod na spyi ltar bya zhing dga' ston la longs spyod/ gsum pa ni/ mchod pa rnams zhal gsos la bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab/ phyi nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas bstod/ he ru ka'i yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sogs nas/ badzra muḥs sindhū ra'i ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa dang*/ gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ mdun bskyed kyi dam tshig pa sindhū ra'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du lte bar oṃ bam̐ sogs go cha dgod/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur sogs bsngo smon dang bkra shis ji ltar rigs par brjod/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ byin rlabs kyi skabs yig rnying dang*/

sgrub thabs rin 'byung sogs las gong du bkod pa dang cung zad mi mthun pa'i khyad par/ bum dbang gi skabs su byur bsal ba sngon du 'gro bas slob ma lha mor bskyed cing go cha sogs dgod par chu dbang bskur/ gsang dbang 'dra/ byin rlabs kyi dngos gzhi slob ma lhar gsal ba dang*/ rtsa sngags kyi byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ bdud rtsis 'thor 'thung bya ba sngon du 'gro bas/ gong bu bsdu ba/ rjes gzhig drod dang*/ mi rtog pa dang*/ bde ba'i ye shes dbab pa rnams kyi mthar brtan par byed pa rnams dbang gong ma gnyis kyi dod thub dang*/ spyod pa'i rjes gnang sbyin par mdzad de/ rgya gzhung gi dgongs par gsungs pa don la gnas mod/ 'dir bkod pa'ang spru lung ba'i yig cha las/ bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len gyis gong 'og 'brel bsdebs te don gyi gnad tshang bar mdzad pa ltar la rgya gzhung sogs kyi dgongs pa med du mi rung bas cung zad brgyan te bkod pa yin pas 'gal bar mi bsam zhing*/ khyad par rang lugs la deng sang gi bar du bla ma rnams kyi phyag gzhes kyang 'di ltar mdzad pa yin no// ngag dbang chos grags kyi yig cha ni spru lung pa'i yi ge'i snying po'i bcud phyungs pa lta bur snang na'ang cung zad bsdus ches bar snang ngo*// gong bu bsdu ba'i skabs ji skad du/ rang lus sum cu rtsa drug khams kyi tshogs// mig sna rna lce lus te dbang po lnga// ngag dang rkang lag bshang gci las dbang lnga// rang bzhin dag kyang de ltar ma rtogs pa'i// ma lus 'gro drug sems can tshogs// las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal gyi// 'khor lo bskor ba 'di dag ni// nges par byang chub la gzhug bya// zhes gsungs te/ de lta bu'i tshul la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje sgyu ma lta bus snod bcud 'od gsal du bsdu ba la 'jug pa yin no// rjes su gzhig pa ni ye shes dbab pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar dang lus bam̐ yig tu gsal ba stong par gzhug pa de yin la/

gang ltar yang stong nyid kyi ngang las rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsgom pa man chad 'dra'o// 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i tshul la/ bsnyen pa ni spru lung pa'i yig cha'i dkyus su gsal/ sindhū ra sgrub pa dang*/ grub nas las la sbyar te spyod pa bya ba'i tshul ni dkyus su mdo tsam gsungs pa ltar/ rgyas par nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i man ngag dang mthun pas de'i khrid yig rnams las gsungs pa ltar shes par bya'o// rig pa 'dzin ma'i byin rlabs tshul// shin tu gsal bar brjod pa'i dges// mkha' spyod grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// sa gsum 'jig rten rgyan gyur cig /ces pa'ang 'jam mgon sa skya pa chen po sogs kyi zhal snga nas tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa maṅga laṃ bhū yā tra// ༈ /mai tri mkha' spyod ma'i byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mkha' spyod dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// spyan ras gzigs dbang blo gros rin chen zhabs// ri khrod dbang phyug grub chen mai tri pa// badzra pā ṇi rnams la gsol ba 'debs// padma rdo rje dza ya se na dang*// sum pa lo tsā rje btsun grags pa'i zhabs// sa paṇa 'phags pa zhang ston brag phug pa// blo gros brtan pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dpal ldan tshul khrims ngor chen rdo rje 'chang*// sems dpa' chen po shes rab bzang po dang*// mkhyen rab chos rje shākya don grub zhabs// kun dga' legs grub rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun dga' chos grags mchog legs rdo rje dang*// bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// kun dga' lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang*// kun dga' blo gros rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan pa'i nyi ma kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// brgyud srol kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// dbang gis rgyud smin dam tshig rnam par dag

/byin rlabs bdud rtsis ye shes skye ba dang*// rim gnyis spyod par bcas pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyis// mkha' spyod go 'phang 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa dge /tshar lugs kyi brgyud pa ltar na rje btsun gong ma man rmor chen gyis mdzad pa'i ind+ra mkha' spyod kyi brgyud pa dang 'dra'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
